entries.title: Tell HN: My kid's school installed spyware and I can't remove it
entries.author: ccleve
entries.current_title: Tell HN: My kid's school installed spyware and I can't remove it
entries.excerpt: My middle schooler goes to Chicago Public Schools. They use Google Classroom for assignments and other communications. I bought him a Chromebook for schoolwork, but also for other private things. When we logged in, the system installed GoGuardian monitoring software on the Chromebook without notice or permission. And now I can't remove it. I wrote to GoGuardian support, and they replied that I had to contact the school or remove my son as a user. The instructions for removing
entries.guide_zh: 家长称学校在私人 Chromebook 安装监控软件，且无法自行移除。

entries.title: Ask HN: Internet magically gets faster when opening speedtest?
entries.author: halgir
entries.current_title: Ask HN: Internet magically gets faster when opening speedtest?
entries.excerpt: I want to start by saying this is anecdotal, and I feel paranoid for even thinking it. But often my internet will feel very slow, so I'll open speedtest to check if something's wrong. When I do, all of my stalled tabs suddenly spring into action and finish loading. The tinfoil hat wearer inside of me speculates that my internet provider is overloaded and throttling my bandwidth, but immediately prioritizes me when it senses that I'm trying to check if I'm getting what I pay f
entries.guide_zh: 打开测速网站网速就变快，发帖者询问这种观察可能有哪些解释。

entries.title: Ask HN: Have you used SQLite as a primary database?
entries.author: barryhennessy
entries.current_title: Ask HN: Have you used SQLite as a primary database?
entries.excerpt: I periodically hear about projects that use/have used sqlite as their sole datastore. The theory seems to be is that you can test out an idea with fewer dependencies (and cost) and that it scales surprisingly far. There are even distributed versions being built for reliability in the cloud: dqlite by canonical (of Ubuntu fame) and rqlite Given the complexity it seems like there are use cases or needs here that I'm not seeing and I'd be very interested to know more from those
entries.guide_zh: SQLite 能否担任主要数据库，寻找把它用于真实项目核心存储的经验。

entries.title: Ask HN: Where can I see many examples of real companies' software architecture?
entries.author: PeledYuval
entries.current_title: Ask HN: Where can I see many examples of real companies' software architecture?
entries.excerpt: I want to broaden my horizon regarding how things are solved in the real world. Other than some very high-profile companies (like Netflix, github) and companies that I've worked at, it's hard for me to find easily digestible (20-60 mins) examples of actual working architecture of differently sized companies from different business verticals.
entries.guide_zh: 想了解实际工程取舍，哪里能看到大量真实公司的软件架构案例？

entries.title: Ask HN: Have you created programs for only your personal use?
entries.author: smarri
entries.current_title: Ask HN: Have you created programs for only your personal use?
entries.excerpt: Curious to know if anyone has written programs for their own, regular, & personal use. And if so what they are? E.g. A colleague of mine tracks all of his homes energy use through a custom program which disaggregates the energy consumption per device and outputs a report to a tablet.
